name: How long does bathroom leak repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom leak repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of bathroom leak repair depends on the complexity and extent of the damage. Simple repairs, like a dripping faucet, can take a few hours. More complex issues involving drywall replacement, flooring repair, or mold remediation could take several days or even weeks, especially if structural drying is required. Your contractor can provide a more precise timeline after assessing the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor leaks to several days or weeks for extensive damage requiring drying and reconstruction.
